title: EtherNet/IP
summary: EtherNet/IP carries the Common Industrial Protocol (CIP) over standard Ethernet. Cyclic I/O uses implicit connections with a requested packet interval (RPI).

sections.heading: Key ideas
sections.body: A scanner (controller) opens connections to adapters (I/O, drives). Explicit messaging reads or writes data on request; implicit (I/O) connections send data cyclically at the RPI. Devices are described by EDS files.

sections.heading: Typical faults
sections.body: Connection timeouts because of a wrong IP address, a duplicate address, an RPI too fast for the device or network congestion; electronic keying mismatches after a module replacement.

sections.heading: In PLC Lab
sections.body: PLC Lab does not simulate this protocol. This article is background knowledge; no conformance or interoperability is claimed.
